task: Put the blue cube on the {colour} square.
task_note: Language-conditioned: the start positions are shared by all four colours, so only the instruction says where to go. Each schedule/evaluation row carries its own task string; episode.py writes it to meta.json and convert_episodes.py uses it as the frame task. A policy without language input (ACT) can at best pick one colour: ~25% ceiling.
object: blue G-Research foam die (~6 cm edge), same object as T1 (t1_protocol.json)
scene: Same table, mat placement (mat_offset_cm 12.3), cameras and lighting as T1; do NOT move the mat, so the pending T1 Diffusion evaluation still runs in the T1 scene. The T1 white box stays where it is and is not used.

targets.description: The four ~5x5 cm colour squares printed on the mat (mat coordinates, cm, from layout/t1_layout_3d.html; +-0.5 cm photo estimates).

reach_estimate_cm.method: affine fit of the 2026-10-15 pilot reach check (A1/A3/C1 dwell poses in the base frame; C3 residual 1.8 cm); horizontal distance from the base yaw axis, +-2 cm
reach_estimate_cm.warning: yellow is at the nominal reach limit for a vertical gripper (~50-52 cm with the 24 cm tool). Check it in the pilot reach check; placing may use a tilted wrist and a release a few cm above the mat. If it cannot be reached, drop yellow and record 20 each of red/green/purple instead of moving the mat.

starts.description: Cube start points near the centre cross, inside the T1 black frame and >= 2 cm from every square (45 deg half-diagonal 4.24 cm). Names follow t1_protocol.json (B12 = midway B1-B2).

episode_structure: start: arm at supported zero pose, gripper near-closed, leader at neutral (as T1)
FIRST ~1 s: the same lift to the fixed look pose as T1
carry to the commanded square, lower until the cube is ~1 cm above the mat, release centred on the square
lift straight up clear of the cube, then return the leader to neutral and hold still until the run ends
setup_prompt: Arm at supported zero pose, gripper near-closed, leader neutral, cube on its start point.
demo_prompt: Demo: lift to the look pose (~1 s), grasp, place the cube centred on the commanded square, release, lift clear, leader to neutral.
accept_rules: cube released with its centre inside the commanded square (the 6 cm cube then covers most of the 5 cm square), not knocked afterwards; judge from the iPhone top-down view
no regrasp of more than one retry
no sensor fault, mirror outcome completed

collection.design: each batch = 12 episodes = every colour 3 times; over the 5 batches every (colour, start) pair occurs exactly 3 times (yaw 0, 45 and one more), so start position carries no information about the colour. Within a batch the order is shuffled with no colour twice in a row.
collection.pilot_note: Before episode 0, bring the fingertips over all four squares with the leader (reach check, especially yellow) and confirm the iPhone top-down view shows every square.

evaluation.in_distribution_note: every (colour, start) pair once, 5 per colour; colour changes every trial; yaw 0/45 alternates by pair
evaluation.policies: ACT (no language input) and SmolVLA, both trained on T2 data only; alternate which goes first per trial as in T1
evaluation.success: cube released with its centre inside the commanded square (operator judgement, iPhone top-down view)

outcome_categories: cube released with its centre inside the commanded square
cube released on a DIFFERENT colour square (note which colour)
never held the cube (missed / pushed it)
grasped, dropped before reaching any square
no task progress before the end (hesitation / freeze)
controller fault, hold latch or policy lost
anything else; describe in the note
